summary: This directory provides a collection of utility functions and wrappers designed to simplify the construction, execution, and management of Effect-based workflows, including stream creation, polling operations, and error handling abstractions.
responsibilities: Facilitating the creation of Effects from asynchronous promises and synchronous functions
Managing execution cycles with polling and sleep utilities
Supporting stream integration from readable sources
Providing runtime runners to execute effects with specified layers
Standardizing error handling and conditional validation within effect chains
relationships: The execution runners use provided layers to resolve the context required by individual effect operations.
Utility functions transform synchronous and asynchronous results into formalized effect types for further composition.
Polling and sleep mechanisms rely on time-based controls to manage the lifecycle of long-running effect processes.
designDecisions: Functional approach to wrapping side-effect-prone operations into type-safe Effect structures
Centralized export strategy through an index file for ease of consumption
Use of factory functions to abstract underlying promise or stream interactions
Decoupling of effect definition from runtime execution
